title: Michael Penix: I'm close to 100 percent, but I'm not there yet

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Michael Penix: I'm close to 100 percent, but I'm not there yet
sources.description: Falcons head coach Kevin Stefanski named Tua Tagovailoa the team's starting quarterback for the first game of the season on Monday and that decision was not made over any objection from Michael Penix.
